blocks.name: Function Entry
blocks.description: Begin an independent function chain in this assembly file.

blocks.name: Comment
blocks.description: Add a readable assembly comment to generated code.

blocks.name: Label
blocks.description: Create a local or global jump target.

blocks.name: Jump to Label
blocks.description: Jump unconditionally to a label in this file.

blocks.name: Call Local Function
blocks.description: Call a function label in the current assembly file.

blocks.name: Return from Function
blocks.description: Return to the instruction after the most recent call.

blocks.name: Loop CX to Label
blocks.description: Decrement CX and jump while it is not zero.

blocks.name: Set Loop Count
blocks.description: Load CX with the number of loop iterations.

blocks.name: Compare Byte and Jump Equal
blocks.description: Compare a byte variable and jump when it equals a value.

blocks.name: Compare Byte and Jump Not Equal
blocks.description: Compare a byte variable and jump when values differ.

blocks.name: Jump If Carry
blocks.description: Jump when the carry flag is set.

blocks.name: Jump If Zero
blocks.description: Jump when the zero flag is set.

blocks.name: Define Byte
blocks.description: Define a named 8-bit value.

blocks.name: Define Word
blocks.description: Define a named 16-bit value.

blocks.name: Subtract Byte
blocks.description: Subtract a constant from an 8-bit variable.

blocks.name: Increment Byte
blocks.description: Increase an 8-bit variable by one.

blocks.name: Decrement Byte
blocks.description: Decrease an 8-bit variable by one.

blocks.name: Set Word
blocks.description: Store a value in a named 16-bit variable.

blocks.name: Add Word
blocks.description: Add a constant to a 16-bit variable.

blocks.name: Subtract Word
blocks.description: Subtract a constant from a 16-bit variable.

blocks.name: Multiply Unsigned Bytes
blocks.description: Multiply two byte values and store the low 8-bit result.

blocks.name: Multiply Unsigned Bytes to Word
blocks.description: Multiply two byte values and store the full 16-bit result.

blocks.name: Divide Unsigned Word
blocks.description: Divide AX by a word and store quotient and remainder.

blocks.name: Negate Word
blocks.description: Replace a word variable with its two's-complement negative.

blocks.name: Bitwise AND Byte
blocks.description: Mask an 8-bit variable with a constant.

blocks.name: Bitwise OR Byte
blocks.description: Set selected bits in an 8-bit variable.

blocks.name: Bitwise XOR Byte
blocks.description: Toggle selected bits in an 8-bit variable.

blocks.name: Shift Word Left
blocks.description: Shift a 16-bit variable left by a constant count.

blocks.name: Shift Word Right
blocks.description: Shift a 16-bit variable right by a constant count.

blocks.name: Write Memory Byte
blocks.description: Write an 8-bit value to a memory address.

blocks.name: Write Memory Word
blocks.description: Write a 16-bit value to a memory address.

blocks.name: Read Memory Byte
blocks.description: Read a byte from memory into a register.

blocks.name: Read Memory Word
blocks.description: Read a word from memory into a register.

blocks.name: Copy Memory Bytes
blocks.description: Copy a fixed number of bytes from DS:SI to ES:DI.

blocks.name: Fill Memory Bytes
blocks.description: Fill ES:DI with an 8-bit value.

blocks.name: Reserve Bytes
blocks.description: Reserve zero-initialized storage in the binary.

blocks.name: Set Register
blocks.description: Load a value into a CPU register.

blocks.name: Move Register
blocks.description: Copy one register into another compatible register.

blocks.name: Swap Registers
blocks.description: Exchange the values of two compatible registers.

blocks.name: Zero Register
blocks.description: Efficiently clear a register.

blocks.name: Push Register
blocks.description: Save a register value on the stack.

blocks.name: Pop Register
blocks.description: Restore a register value from the stack.

blocks.name: Push All Registers
blocks.description: Save all general-purpose 16-bit registers.

blocks.name: Pop All Registers
blocks.description: Restore all general-purpose 16-bit registers.

blocks.name: Read Key into Byte
blocks.description: Wait for a key and save its ASCII value in a byte variable.

blocks.name: Check for Key
blocks.description: Set a byte to 1 when a key is waiting, otherwise set it to 0.
blocks.asm_code:
mov byte [{VAR}], 0
mov ah, 0x01
int 0x16
jz .no_key_{ID}
mov byte [{VAR}], 1
.no_key_{ID}:

blocks.name: Print Character
blocks.description: Print one character using the current text display.

blocks.name: Print New Line
blocks.description: Move text output to the beginning of the next line.
blocks.asm_code:
mov ah, 0x0e
mov al, 13
int 0x10
mov al, 10
int 0x10

blocks.name: Set Text Color
blocks.description: Load a text color attribute into BL for compatible print routines.

blocks.name: String Length
blocks.description: Count characters in a zero-terminated string into CX.

blocks.name: Copy String
blocks.description: Copy a zero-terminated string to another buffer.

blocks.name: Include Assembly File
blocks.description: Insert another assembly source file at this position.

blocks.name: Include Binary File
blocks.description: Embed a binary resource in the output.

blocks.name: Define Raw Bytes
blocks.description: Add comma-separated byte values or quoted text.

blocks.name: Align Output
blocks.description: Pad output to the requested byte alignment.

blocks.name: No Operation
blocks.description: Emit one NOP instruction.

blocks.name: Disable Interrupts
blocks.description: Clear the interrupt flag.

blocks.name: Enable Interrupts
blocks.description: Set the interrupt flag.

blocks.name: Read I/O Port
blocks.description: Read one byte from a hardware port into AL.

blocks.name: Write I/O Port
blocks.description: Write one byte from AL to a hardware port.

blocks.name: Stop PC Speaker
blocks.description: Turn off the PC speaker gate.
blocks.asm_code:
in al, 0x61
and al, 0xfc
out 0x61, al
